stem: How did the White Ribboners contribute to U.S. society during the late 1800s?

options.label: F
options.text: By supporting the movement to end Reconstruction and Jim Crow

options.label: G
options.text: By establishing labor unions for women and children

options.label: H
options.text: By winning the right to vote for African Americans and immigrants

options.label: J
options.text: By leading efforts to achieve prohibition and women's suffrage

visual_elements: Excerpt titled “Do Everything” from A Handbook for the World's White Ribboners, 1895, discussing the goals of the WCTU including respect for Sabbath, rights of the poor, prohibition, and protection of the home.
